_source: Static UI keys for the mobile foreman progress screen (route fm-progress, pototype/mobile-field.jsx MFmProgress L92-143). KEYS ONLY, like pm_checkin_strings.json: every value is a DICT stable-id resolved with i18n.t. Six keys were minted for this screen (mob.fm.progress.*), each byte-exact from the prototype. NOT minted, deliberately: the eyebrow's full text 'โฟร์แมน · สมคิด ร. · Block B' (a mock person and a mock block — only the role word is minted, the rest comes from the wire or em-dashes) and the submit toast 'ส่ง % งาน Block B แล้ว · เฉลี่ย {n}% → อัปเดต Progress + งวดงาน' (embeds the same mock block; the screen re-reads after a submit, which shows the truth rather than claiming it).
_layers: all t() = dict (a stable id resolved from i18n-full.json). NO phrases-layer (Thai-as-key) entries here.
